scripts.build: node tools/build/clean-dist.mjs && npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && node tools/build/esbuild.mjs && npx tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && npm run lint:deps && npm run lint:css && node tools/build/copy-static.mjs && node tools/build/generate-asset-manifest.mjs
scripts.start: npm run build && npx http-server dist -p 8000 -c-1
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:embedded
scripts.test:e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_DOCKER=1 npm run build && npx playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.test:e2e:firefox: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_DOCKER=1 npm run build && npx playwright test --project=firefox
scripts.test:e2e:embedded: PLAYWRIGHT_USE_DOCKER=1 SERVER_STATIC_MODE=embedded bash -lc 'npm run build && npx playwright test tests/embedded-static.spec.ts --project=chromium'
